subject.title: Bug: Hybrid memory search silently fails when node:sqlite is compiled without extension loading support

question: Does a focused current-main reproduction show that sqlite-vec unavailability discards otherwise valid FTS or in-process fallback candidates, and should that existing fallback contract be restored before changing database-handle extension policy?
rationale: The issue presents a plausible concrete regression, but its proposed one-line handle change relies on an unverified explanation and could change extension-loading policy beyond memory search.

options.title: Reproduce fallback loss first
options.body: Validate the reported Node/macOS setup and repair candidate preservation plus diagnostics at the memory-search boundary if the fallback contract is broken.

options.title: Adopt the shared-handle design
options.body: Approve a scoped refactor to use an extension-capable memory handle only after confirming it is required and assessing extension-loading policy.

recommendation.title: Reproduce fallback loss first
recommendation.body: Validate the reported Node/macOS setup and repair candidate preservation plus diagnostics at the memory-search boundary if the fallback contract is broken.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter is the only identified participant with a detailed live environment and reproducible observations; a code-area owner still needs to be identified from current history.
